lateral_torso_line_topology.vertical_line_count_and_spacing: 12 distinct vertical white lines; spacing is relatively uniform across the torso, with a slight increase in density toward the posterior.
lateral_torso_line_topology.discontinuity_mapping: The two anterior-most lines (adjacent to the neck) and the posterior-most line (near the tail) are significantly abbreviated, terminating at mid-torso height.

posterior_constellation_clusters.spatial_cluster_density: Low-density cluster of 3-4 distinct white spots on the lateral lower haunch and upper hind limb.

macro_horn_vector_geometry.curve_trajectory_2d: The visible horn displays a lyrate curvature, ascending with a backward and inward spiral relative to the skull base.
macro_horn_vector_geometry.terminal_contrast_ratio: High-contrast ivory tipping accounts for approximately 15% of the total vertical length of the visible horn structure.

other_distinctive_markers: White facial markings including a chevron between the eyes and spots on the cheeks, along with white bands on the lower limbs.
